findings.issue: Refresh dates are reconstructed from positive-gross box-office history. A degraded production run with no resolved grosses—possible before the season starts—leaves no persistent record of its date. Although the current render temporarily adds today, later builds lose that date and interpolate across the missing refresh, violating the requirement that every production refresh appear and missing forecasts break the line.
findings.suggestion: Persist production refresh dates independently of gross and forecast rows, then use that durable run-date history to build the chart axis.

findings.issue: Omitting `--date` reads `date.today()`, so wall-clock time affects projections, output timestamps, and production history without an explicitly passed run date. This violates the repository and spec reproducibility requirement that wall-clock time enter only through an explicit `--date`.
findings.suggestion: Make `--date` required and update the documented local and production commands to pass an ISO date explicitly.
